Definition: a Tsidonian or inhabitant of Tsidon
BiblicalUsage: A Sidonian is an inhabitant of Sidon, the ancient Phoenician seaport. In Deuteronomy 3:9, Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion. The fuller story is told on the Sidon profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Sidonian matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
